action_items.item_text: Lead partner must be a substantial partner in JV/Consortium with minimum 26% participation and past similar work experience
action_items.evidence_quote: Lead partner must be a substantial partner in the JV/Consortium i.e. it should have a minimum of 26% participation in the JV/Consortium. Each substantial partner in case of JV/Consortium shall have experience of executing at least one “similar work” ** of value of ₹274.28 lakhs or more in last 05 years

action_items.item_text: Each non-substantial partner should have a minimum of 20% participation in the JV/Consortium
action_items.evidence_quote: b. Each non-substantial partner should have a minimum of 20% participation in the JV/Consortium. Partners having less than 26% participation will be termed as non-substantial partner and their financial soundness shall not be considered for evaluation of JV/Consortium.

action_items.item_text: In case of JV/Consortium change in constitution or percentage participation not permitted after application submission
action_items.evidence_quote: c. In case of JV/Consortium, change in constitution or percentage participation shall not be permitted at any stage after their submission of application otherwise the applicant shall be treated as non-responsive.
